svg.title: ChickenWings-0: GitHub activity as a topographic map
svg.desc: Contour map of 466 contributions over the 52 weeks to 2026-11-16. Time runs left to right, each ridge is a repository, height is contributions per week on a log scale. Numbered summits: 1 JOC (Apr 2026), 2 maitri (May 2026), 4 SatQuery-AI (Sep 2026), 6 OOPS-PBL (Nov 2026).
svg.text: Relief: contributions per week, log scale
